content:
maria: Heads-up — scheduling Archipelago Systems Dedicated rollout for Thu 2026-03-10 02:00-04:00 UTC. Requesting dry-run + approval. KMS rotation is set for 09:00 UTC that day, so we must avoid key overlap. Pin version: archipelago-dedicated:v2026-03-tilt-rc3.

devon: ack. Can we do a dry-run on slice-3 first? want to validate KV priming and model weights.

sam: +1 for slice-3 dry-run. Also share exact rollback steps and SLO watchlist pls.

maria: Plan: 1) dry-run on slice-3 (no traffic) 2) canary (2% traffic, 30m) 3) ramp to 25% (1h) 4) full shift. Rollback: traffic shift back to stable slice, scale down new fleet, revert pin to v2026-02-stable if needed. SLOs: p99 latency < 220ms, error rate < 0.5%.

olivia: oncall ack — will watch latency and error-rate dashboards, have runbooks open. If p99 > 300ms for >5m, we trigger immediate rollback.

maria: deploy-bot, run dry-run on slice-3.

deploy-bot: Received command: `/deploy dry-run archipelago-dedicated:v2026-03-tilt-rc3 --slice=slice-3 --env=dedicated --check=kvcache,weights,network`

deploy-bot: Dry-run started...

deploy-bot: Dry-run output:
```
[2026-03-08T15:02:34Z] kvcache: priming OK (10k keys)
[2026-03-08T15:02:36Z] model weights load: OK (quantized)
[2026-03-08T15:02:40Z] gpu-driver: WARN: driver mismatch on node g-ded-07 (expected 525.x, found 520.x)
[2026-03-08T15:02:45Z] network: latency sim OK
[2026-03-08T15:02:46Z] dry-run: completed WITH WARNINGS
```

devon: that driver mismatch is concerning — g-ded-07 is in slice-3 canary set? if yes we should exclude it or replace before canary.

maria: confirmed g-ded-07 is in slice-3. ops-bot can you cordon that node and re-run dry-run?

ops-bot: Node g-ded-07 cordoned. Scheduling replacement from pool ded-replace-24.

deploy-bot: Re-running dry-run (after cordon) with same flags...

deploy-bot: Dry-run output:
```
[2026-03-08T15:15:12Z] kvcache: priming OK
[2026-03-08T15:15:14Z] model weights load: OK
[2026-03-08T15:15:18Z] gpu-driver: OK (525.4)
[2026-03-08T15:15:22Z] all checks PASSED
```

sam: looks good. Can we add a traffic-slice pin in the rollout plan so we can flip back fast? e.g. keep stable-slice pinned and move agent-route with a single api call.

maria: yes — we'll use the route pin: `POST /admin/route-shift { "customer": "archipelago", "from": "stable-slice", "to": "archipelago-slice-3", "percent": 2 }` for canary then similar calls to ramp.

olivia: I'm good to approve once KMS collision window confirmed. KMS rotation mentioned earlier is at 09:00 UTC — that is safe (7h after our final shift). no overlap.

sam: does the release note include the model quantization change? ops needs it to check perf baseline.

maria: included in release notes draft: "Quantized model v2026-03 reduces memory footprint; expected latency change <5%". Will attach perf baseline to the ticket.

devon: who signs off on emergency rollback? ops-oncall + eng-release lead?

maria: emergency rollback approval path: olivia (oncall) + devon as eng-release lead. Both must ack in this thread to execute immediate rollback.

olivia: ack — will ack in-thread during rollout.

devon: ack — I will be available in the window.

maria: final ask: please react with :thumbsup: here to approve schedule and rollback path.

olivia: :thumbsup:

devon: :thumbsup: 

sam: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout job created: job_id=rb-1747212345-archipelago. Canary window: 2026-03-10T02:10:00Z -> 02:40:00Z. Full ramp starts 02:45:00Z.

maria: thanks all — I'll post final release note link and the runbook in the ticket. Will ping again 30m before the window.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 30m before rollout window -> post to #eng-releases.

maria: (posting runbook link) https://rwd.internal/tickets/ARCH-4523/runbook — includes rollback API calls, SLOs, and contact list.

sam: noted. ttyl during window.

olivia: oncall ready.
